Plan-review: PASS (0 blocking, 1 minor E2 advisory — the constant-pinning predicate; already implemented as `_PINNED_VALUE_TYPES = (str,int,bool,tuple,frozenset)` in gen_api_surface.py). Claimed and implemented.

Pushed Gerrit change 2196 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2196).

What changed:
- NEW scripts/gen_api_surface.py: pure-stdlib (inspect/importlib) public-API surface introspection + --check/--update drift gate, modelled on scripts/gen_config_reference.py. No new dependency (griffe NOT added).
- NEW tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json: committed surface baseline.
- NEW tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py: portable unit-tier gate (14 tests). Authoritative --check runs in a clean subprocess so it reflects the real installed surface, immune to the unit tier's autouse rebar.append_session_log monkeypatch.
- DELETED tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py: hardcoded-subset assertions subsumed; four test_subsumes_* tests prove no coverage loss.
- docs/reuse-surface.md note updated to name the new gate.

Source-of-truth rule: union over MODULES (rebar facade + documented reuse subsystems) of each module's public members (__all__ if defined, else owned non-underscore attrs).

RED->GREEN proof: removing 'reopen' from rebar.__all__ makes 'python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check' exit 1 ('- REMOVED rebar.reopen'); restoring returns exit 0. In-test: test_check_trips_when_a_public_symbol_is_removed/_added/_signature_changes.

Gates: make lint OK, make typecheck OK, complexity baseline new=0 increased=0, targeted make test subset green. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
